stories.headline: Leadership uncertainty rattles Nvidia
stories.summary: Reuters reports Nvidia's board is weighing Jensen Huang's future. Investors worry a leadership change could affect its AI investments and customer financing. No removal is confirmed in the report.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO targets up to $64.4 billion
stories.summary: Reuters reports a planned $70-$78 share range and fundraising target up to $64.4 billion. Index-linked demand could influence early trading; neither a successful offering nor future returns is assured.

stories.headline: US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October
stories.summary: BLS reports seasonally adjusted CPI rose 0.4% in October; core CPI rose 0.3%. Missing October 2025 survey data prevent many year-over-year comparisons. These are monthly changes, not annual inflation rates.

stories.headline: Russia and Ukraine agree to prisoner exchange
stories.summary: Negotiators agreed in principle to a major prisoner exchange, with numbers still to be determined. Territorial disputes remain unresolved; the humanitarian agreement is not a peace settlement.

stories.headline: Hormuz risks persist despite lower oil prices
stories.summary: Oil edged lower as rising output offset geopolitical risks. Iran reported further mine damage to tankers; that account remains attributed. Nuclear disagreements and shipping disruption continue.
